root_cause.top: The visible native TOP fallback pointed only at href=# and had no explicit page-top fragment target or pointer/touch ownership, so live mobile could render the control without reliable interaction.
root_cause.loading: Client loading takeover waited on a 140ms timer plus Streamlit script-state timing, while the server fallback rendered only when the client controller failed; a successful controller could therefore leave stale page content exposed during a slow destination load.

tdd.first_patch_root_cause: Frozen Universal Page Experience V1 regression requires the literal document.scrollingElement fallback contract; first patch narrowed it to doc.scrollingElement.
tdd.compatibility_patch: Restore document.scrollingElement as a real fallback in scroll-owner resolution while preserving the parent-document owner path.

repair.top: Add a real page-top sentinel before the site shell, target it from the native TOP anchor, force pointer/touch ownership, and have the client enhancer prevent default then scroll the actual owner.
repair.loading: Show the client overlay immediately for page-changing intents while CSS delays visible reveal by 120ms, and unconditionally mount a branded server takeover on route transitions before destination loading; clear it only after a successful destination commit.
